wiki.title: Mike Bousselot
wiki.extract: Michael Robert Bousselot (born November 2, 1982) is an American attorney, political advisor, and politician serving as a member of the Iowa Senate from the 21st District. From 2021-2023, he was a member of the Iowa House of Representatives, representing the 37th district. He is a Republican. Bousselot has been described as having "deep personal, professional and economic ties" to Summit Agricultural Group.
